messages:
ana-recruiter: Quick flag  panel for C-332 today - interviewers report no scorecard link in calendar. Few panels impacted.

sarah-peopleops: Which invite id? can you drop one example?

ana-recruiter: invite-22c. Calendar body only says 'Interview with Redwood'. No attachments.

ats-bot: ats-bot: webhook_delivery id=7c4e - status=202 then 409 conflict for invite-22c

maria-hiringops: I see the scorecard object in ATS but enrichment worker raised mapping_exists on the second attempt. Looks like the new parallel enrichment path caused a race.

devon-intops: Rolling a very small mitigation: if enrichment not reflected in calendar after 20s, append fallback link to invite body. Pushing now.

ana-recruiter: Can recruiting get a quick UI marker for invites missing scorecards? chasing live panels is a pain.

sarah-peopleops: Agreed. For now Maria, can you run a one-off audit for today's panels and DM recruiters? we'll backlog the UI indicator.

maria-hiringops: On it. Also a couple interviewers mentioned their "trained" badge wasn't visible even though they completed the session yesterday. I'll verify event ordering for training writes.

devon-intops: Likely cache staleness. I'll force roster cache invalidation on training write and add an idempotency guard to enrichment.

ana-recruiter: Thanks team. Patch applied and calendar bodies updated for affected invites. I messaged panels.

ats-bot: ats-bot: calendar_patch_succeeded invite-22c at 1865432137

sarah-peopleops: Great response time. We'll capture follow-ups in the interview ops playbook and mark this P1 for next sprint. :clap:
